name.en: UP-21 IoT / event-triggered process with storm control
name.hi: यूपी-21 आईओटी / घटना-प्रेरित प्रक्रिया एवं तूफ़ान नियंत्रण

description: An alarm starts one case per device; repeats correlate to it (de-duplicated, bounded), a debounce window waits, a threshold decides whether to dispatch, and a clear event closes it automatically (R83, R40).
